text:
Priya K: Quick heads-up — running a dry-run for partner SEV handoff with AtlasCloud (marketplace + SI) this Fri 10:00am PT. Goal: validate shared channel, phone bridge, and escalation hops. Need on-call + partner liaisons. :eyes:

Jonas H: I can be on-call for Redwood side. What channel name? :thumbsup:

Priya K: Thanks. Using #partner-sev-dryrun (internal) and we've set up a shared channel with AtlasCloud called "atlas-redwood-sev". Also we'll test dual-bridge fallback. Invite list: Jonas, Eli, Taylor, Mike, Atlas SRE lead (will join from partner side).

Eli M: Confirmed for phone bridge. Dial-in: +1-555-0100, PIN 8981 then 1234#. I'll script auto-join for the dry-run.

Taylor S: I'll walk the runbook and simulate a model-serving degradation leading to handoff. Quick checklist: 1) Alert triggers 2) Open warroom 3) Share context 4) Escalate to partner 5) Handoff complete.

Mike L: Can someone paste the exact escalation hops? Need it for on-call notes.

Priya K: Hops:
1) On-call -> internal triage (Redwood SRE)
2) If RCA > 20m or 1 customer impacted -> open shared channel + phone bridge
3) Add partner liaison if partner resources referenced
4) If service impact extends > 45m escalate to engineering pager and legal/comms notify

Eli M: I'll add a short ops playbook snippet to the shared channel during the run.

Jonas H: Can we include a step to test fallback model routing? Want to ensure graceful degradation works.

Taylor S: Yes — step 2a: trigger automatic fallback to quantized model in another region and validate responses.

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: Dry-run for partner SEV handoff — Fri 10:00am PT — channel #partner-sev-dryrun — will post join link 10m prior.

Priya K: Cool. Last ask: please have someone capture a short post-mortem template during the run (what worked, hiccups, time-to-handoff). I'll run a 30m follow-up sync next Mon 9am PT.

Mike L: I'll take notes. :white_check_mark:

Jonas H: See you all Friday. :coffee:
